name: Fever / Pyrexia
description: Core body temperature elevation > 100.4°F.

name: High Fever (>103°F)
description: High temperature elevation that can trigger seizures.

name: Chills & Shivering
description: Involuntary muscular contractions due to rapid temperature shifts.

name: Night Sweats
description: Severe drenching perspiration during sleep requiring clothes change.

name: Fatigue & Malaise
description: Overwhelming exhaustion and decreased energy capacity.

name: Unintentional Weight Loss
description: Loss of >5% body weight without dietary restriction.

name: Headache
description: Aching pain anywhere in the cranial region.

name: Throbbing Unilateral Headache
description: Pulsating headache typical of migraine attacks.

name: Dizziness / Vertigo
description: Sensation of unsteadiness, spinning room, or near-syncope.

name: Confusion & Altered Sensorium
description: Disorientation, difficulty thinking clearly, or delirium.

name: Seizures / Convulsions
description: Uncontrolled electrical disturbance in the brain causing jerking.

name: Chest Pain / Pressure
description: Retrosternal squeezing, burning, or tightness.

name: Palpitations / Rapid Pulse
description: Awareness of pounding, fluttering, or irregular heartbeat.

name: Pedal Edema (Leg Swelling)
description: Puffy fluid accumulation in feet, ankles, and shins.

name: Shortness of Breath (Dyspnea)
description: Difficulty breathing or feeling starved of oxygen.

name: Wheezing
description: Musical whistling breath sounds during exhalation.

name: Dry Cough
description: Non-productive irritating cough without sputum production.

name: Productive Cough (Phlegm)
description: Cough expelling yellow, green, or thick mucous.

name: Coughing Blood (Hemoptysis)
description: Blood or blood-streaked mucus expelled from airways.

name: Sore Throat (Pharyngitis)
description: Pain, irritation, or scratchiness in the throat.

name: Runny Nose (Rhinorrhea)
description: Excessive watery discharge from nasal cavities.

name: Nasal Congestion / Blockage
description: Swollen nasal passages blocking airflow.

name: Loss of Smell (Anosmia)
description: Inability to detect odors and aromas.

name: Loss of Taste (Ageusia)
description: Loss of gustatory sensations.

name: Nausea
description: Queasy feeling with urge to vomit.

name: Vomiting (Emesis)
description: Forceful ejection of stomach contents through mouth.

name: Diarrhea
description: Frequent watery or loose bowel movements.

name: Blood in Stool (Melena / Hematochezia)
description: Visible red blood or dark black tarry feces.

name: Abdominal Cramps & Pain
description: Sharp, dull, or colicky pain in abdominal cavity.

name: Heartburn / Acid Regurgitation
description: Burning sensation rising from stomach to throat.

name: Bloating & Gas
description: Feeling of full, distended abdominal tightness.

name: Difficulty Swallowing (Dysphagia)
description: Food sticking or painful passage through esophagus.

name: Jaundice (Yellow Eyes / Skin)
description: Bilirubin pigment buildup turning sclera and skin yellow.

name: Dark Amber / Tea-Colored Urine
description: High bilirubin or severe dehydration darkening urine.

name: Clay-Colored / Pale Stool
description: Lack of bile pigment in bowel movements.

name: Joint Pain (Arthralgia)
description: Aching or throbbing in knees, wrists, elbows, ankles.

name: Muscle Aches (Myalgia)
description: Diffuse soreness across major muscle groups.

name: Back Pain
description: Discomfort or tension along spinal vertebral column.

name: Eye Pain (Retro-orbital Pain)
description: Deep ache behind eyeballs worsened by eye movement.

name: Red / Watery Eyes (Conjunctivitis)
description: Hyperemic conjunctiva with discharge or tearing.

name: Light Sensitivity (Photophobia)
description: Discomfort or ocular pain caused by bright lights.

name: Skin Rash / Eruption
description: Red spots, bumps, or patches on skin.

name: Fluid-Filled Blisters
description: Vesicles containing clear fluid on skin surface.

name: Petechiae (Pinpoint Bleed Spots)
description: Tiny non-blanching red or purple intradermal spots.

name: Severe Pruritus (Itching)
description: Persistent urge to scratch cutaneous surfaces.

name: Excessive Thirst (Polydipsia)
description: Constant unquenchable craving for fluids.

name: Frequent Urination (Polyuria)
description: High volume or high frequency of urination.

name: Zero Urine Output (Anuria)
description: Absence of urine for over 8-12 hours.

name: Foamy / Bubbly Urine
description: Excessive bubbles indicating proteinuria in urine.

name: Bleeding Gums / Spontaneous Bleed
description: Spontaneous bleeding from oral mucosa.

name: Pale Conjunctiva & Skin (Pallor)
description: Whitish discoloration of inner eyelids and nailbeds.

name: Cold Clammy Hands & Feet
description: Peripheral vasoconstriction indicating shock or fever spike.
